DNA end resection.fact: DNA end resection, also called 5′–3′ ("five-prime to three-prime") degradation, is a biochemical process where the blunt end of a section of double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) is modified by cutting away some nucleotides from the 5' end to produce a 3' single-stranded sequence.
